_comment: Use this when Claude Code runs on a DIFFERENT machine than FrameworX (Mac, VM, or a separate PC). Copy it over .mcp.json and replace YOUR-WINDOWS-IP with the LAN address of the Windows machine running FrameworX. Open ports 10150, 10151, 10120 in Windows Firewall on that machine. FrameworX 10.1.6 or later: set an X_API_KEY on each bridge and set the FX_MCP_API_KEY environment variable to it on this machine before starting Claude Code. FrameworX 10.1.5: delete the two --header entries from each server. See KnowledgeBase/Method/mcp-setup.md for the full explanation and the auth model.
